the plan’s l2 residual-bash work calls out trailing `# lint-prefix-case-variant: ok` suppressions only on the two `printf` fixture lines that embed legacy `### [bug]` headings (`scripts/test-file-failure-report-cross-repo.sh:246`, `295`). the same manifest-listed script also carries literal `[bug]` on `assert_eq` expected-string lines `248` and `298` (for example, `"tier-b: legacy [bug] raw heading rejected"` and `"design-prefix: legacy [bug] raw /design heading rejected"`). the new `lint prefix-case-variant` rule scans every line in residual bash files with no heading-only carve-out, so those assertion messages are case variants of the canonical `[bug]` token and will still be reported. if the implementer suppresses only the two `printf` lines, `python3 python/cli.py lint prefix-case-variant` will still exit 1 and acceptance criterion 2 (repo-wide zero findings) will fail.
